identity.description: Twenty (twentyhq/twenty) is an open-source CRM, positioned as 'the open alternative to Salesforce, designed for AI', offered as self-hosted (Docker Compose) or Twenty Cloud.
identity.identity_notes: GitHub repo owner is twentyhq and the repo describes the open alternative to Salesforce. Docs at docs.twenty.com and twenty.com match the product name and CRM category.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization code + PKCE for user-facing apps (/oauth/authorize, /oauth/token); client credentials for server-to-server integrations. Clients are registered dynamically via RFC 7591.
auth.token_refresh: Refresh via POST to /oauth/token with grant_type=refresh_token, refresh_token, client_id and client_secret (per OAuth docs example).
auth.scopes_notes: OAuth scope 'api' gives full read/write access to Core and Metadata APIs; scope 'profile' reads authenticated user's profile. Scopes are space-separated. API keys can be scoped to a role (Settings > Members > Roles).

access.production_restrictions: Self-hosted open-source core is free. Twenty Cloud offers a 30-day free trial without credit card. Pricing page lists API access under Pro ($9/user/month); the quoted feature-table claim was summarized, not quoted verbatim, so verify. No app review documented for API keys; OAuth app review/approval not established.

read_ops: Traverse relations in one GraphQL query
write_ops: Batch create/update/delete up to 60 records per request
api.rate_limits: 100 requests per minute on Organization plan; 50 calls per minute on Pro (per pricing page summary, verify).
api.limitations: Batch size capped at 60 records per request. Webhooks currently send all event types; event filtering may be added later. Core and metadata APIs are generated from each workspace's data model, so docs are workspace-specific.
